purpose: Commissioned native integration and proof obligations within the existing #65 UX spine; no new story IDs, runtime, storage or evidence system.

grounding220.policy: Read full source, current owner tickets and exact source cut. These joins preserve accepted Factory design and earlier stories/obligations; declaration is not runtime or human evidence.

obligations.requirement: Choose or continue legitimate existing/new work with real source, working destination and required/preferred environment; preserve thin/external sessions and the explicit rich Herdr reference.
required_branches: Root versus Project NOW follows actual concern; material cwd and source ownership remain distinct.
No forced source migration or adoption of a guessed Guardian default.
A required host/environment cannot silently fall back; a preference can resolve only with a disclosed supported alternative.

obligations.requirement: Maintain exact AgentSession/SessionSpace/provider/material relations across view movement, re-observation, explicit recreation and concurrent sessions.
required_branches: Two sessions may share Project, executable, labels and even numeric PID across hosts; host/start marker/provider generation distinguishes material.
Stale binding or reused pane/session name must not redirect input, interrupt or close.
View continuity, native resume, context rehydration and successor session retain distinct evidence.
Creation interrupted before binding persistence reconciles material before another task starts.

obligations.requirement: Extend actual Workcell observations to provider places and each live process, preserving executable-based inventory aggregation and external unattributed work.
required_branches: Reuse resource_usage process-start/executable evidence; a PID is not identity.
Unknown/failed/stale reads remain unknown, never empty healthy state or invented Agent/Factory ancestry.
Local and selected remote observations retain source, freshness, lifetime and authority; no new Central-like meta register.
Foreign processes and resident services survive bounded observation and cleanup.

obligations.requirement: Make the existing Herdr adapter reachable through AIKit public environment operations and retained working-Surface bindings; prove actual open/attach/focus/close/recovery with supported providers.
required_branches: Herdr reference, tmux portability and optional cmux each require their own real evidence.
Keep #311 unpublished work and ReobservedUnproven/ReboundByExplicitOpen semantics; don't reconstruct another session to claim resume.
Isolate tmux clients when their target dies; no switch/input leakage to a resident job and no global config rewrite.
Separate Herdr valid-PTY missing-target behaviour from no-TTY preflight; use actual installed command syntax.
Closing a view, interrupting a turn, closing a pane and destroying its material have different effects.

obligations.requirement: Resolve source/identity/praxis/context/model/harness/environment/authority through the existing native composition and expose confirmed target-effective behaviour.
required_branches: Scope-neutral composition includes Herdr, graphical and client/UI contributions; do not make all composition harness-shaped.
Distinguish resolution scope, activation scope and lifetime, selected/projected/loaded/action-usable/enforced states.
Two sessions in one Project with different context/skills remain isolated when one changes.
Native model policy/routes, required tools and harness faculties re-resolve together; no private desktop roster.
Useful permitted source-dependent task proves loading; generated file alone is insufficient and unsupported readback remains explicit.

obligations.requirement: Join actual governing authority to a bounded grant and admitted Agency, then exact prepared body, real dispatch/result and attributable Activity; correlate Factory only when commissioned.
required_branches: Actuation #84 continues accepted Rust #58; do not rebuild the gate or let Factory/React fabricate grants.
Wrong holder, World, operation, bounds, revoked/expired or unknown authority refuses before effects.
Addressing, session contribution, delegation and independent cooperation retain their native differences.
Children have bounded effects/lifetime/budget/return and independent verification; no model impersonating a second actor.
A gateway append, transport ack, terminal creation or human unsent draft does not stand in for actual Agent action.

obligations.requirement: Prove permitted work and return routes through detached UI, connection loss and selected service/provider restart, with exact native continuity or explicit recovery.
required_branches: Provider server, Workcell service, Gateway and UI have separate lifetimes and tested failure boundaries.
Account for pending tool/permission, uncertain external effect, late response and replay before consequential retry.
Context/history restoration is not native session resume; re-created process is not the old material.
Failure of one selected provider/connection leaves unrelated sessions usable.
No unsupported exactly-once guarantee or hidden duplicated turn on restart.

obligations.requirement: Prove remote access to the same living work separately from deliberate execution re-placement on a real second material host.
required_branches: Multi-host view leaves processes on their owning hosts; source sync, access and execution movement stay separate.
Resolve target offers/source/storage/credentials/authority with no silent required-target fallback.
Account for in-flight effects; preserve bounded permitted context, exact Git basis and obligations; revalidate target loading and authority.
Resume only where native support proves it; otherwise identify rehydration/successor and old/new attempt/material relation.
Prove target operation before release; prevent competing consequential execution and reconcile late old-host output.
Two directories and sampled differing IDs do not prove second-host recovery or permanent identifier uniqueness.

obligations.requirement: Recover existing Field Guardian/product Agent expressions, formation/default/skill provenance, resolve supported selections and prove actual ordinary harness activation.
required_branches: Central world default_agent_set_ref and orchestrator_agent_ref already exist; repair consumers and source gaps rather than recreate fields.
Generic support, declared source, local adoption, effective selection and target loading are separate.
Private source/default adoption remains the owner's actual scoped choice; explicit and profile-less legitimate work remains usable.
Purpose/Focus/Knowledge/praxis differentiates Guardians; no privileged meta-profile class or authority from being a Guardian.
Central source operations stay in C; AIKit readers/projection/loading stay in A.

obligations.requirement: Carry real commissioned work through exact admitted execution, independent work/verification, native Git, durable structured outputs/handoff and Central temporal continuation.
required_branches: Trace Run/attempt, Agency/session, working Surface, material observation, Activity and exact tested Git basis.
Queued Run plus unrelated terminal never counts as Factory execution; native direct/external work stays valid.
Actual result bodies remain reachable after terminal/view closure and feed the adopted shared HTML template family.
New revision exposes stale evidence; completion, Recognition and Git integration stay distinct.
NOW references actual material; supported Routine re-entry revalidates authority/proof and does not derive scheduling from reconnect or DAY rollover.

obligations.requirement: Connect native desktop/TUI/Gateway/Omarchy entry and attention to exact current work, preserving accepted Factory and ordinary arrangements.
required_branches: One canonical conversation Surface; movement preserves draft/focus and does not clone or redirect work.
Factory centre work/right artifacts/footer attention remains the accepted design.
Provider-bound focus and alternate Surface open exact permitted subject; denied compositor action gets supported recovery.
Closing desktop leaves supported work alive; one unavailable service does not obscure unrelated usable work.
Record narrow/medium/wide and keyboard/pointer behaviour in actual installed host; human visual acceptance remains separate.

obligations.requirement: Execute the complete connected source→operative Agent→Herdr Factory work alongside Direct tmux/external harness→independent verification→output→recovery→real remote access/re-placement→NOW/recurrence walk.
required_branches: Exercise every available admitted harness against actual faculties with economical eligible models; label unavailable/unsupported/failed branches.
Preserve original TM02 failed certification and bounded successes; repair invalid syntax/count/PTY/PID assertions without rewriting evidence.
Keep actual source/build/install/running/provider versions, production checks and real material receipts; fixtures establish only their own boundary.
Independent verifier tests the same changed cut; required H comes from the human.
Existing CAW/QL/installation and Factory obligations remain; no provider smoke or map compilation closes the whole.

closure: A integrates native results; U completes accepted desktop experience; W/C are independent optional staffing. #201/#202–205 and #65 retain independent and human evidence requirements. No plan/test declaration promotes runtime readiness.
